analysis: The supplied units are CHANGELOG.md head text, which describes a v0.10.13 candidate release (unpublished) and carries prior-release notes. The patch excerpt shows only documentation changes in lines 11-45 of head (version header, Upgrade and rollout notes, highlights). No executable code, configuration, or permission logic is changed in this file. I examined the narrative claims against the threat model: prefix-cache statements (Nemotron prefix bank, GLM encrypted SSD prefix store default-on, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0 opt-out, 'Prefix reuse is partitioned by the authenticated cache scope', DEBUG-only DARKBLOOM_DEBUG_CACHE_KEY_FILE not present in release builds) are consistent with T-041 (HMAC-keyed names, coordinator-authored scope, kill switch) and do not state any loosening of the TTL, scope derivation or crypto. The SSD restore staging cap increase (7 GiB/15 s) is a performance and transient-RAM change, not an at-rest change, and the daily write cap is unchanged. Hash-with-F_NOCACHE weight hashing leaves digests unchanged (A-004/T-012 unaffected). Image/video ingress bounds and 400-before-reservation refusals are DoS-hardening. The environment-variable rollbacks are documented as not forwarded to LaunchAgents in some cases; they are operator-controlled. The staging build environment and master-push staging publish (gated by STAGING_ENABLED, same Developer-ID cert as dev/prod) are release-pipeline changes described only in prose; the actual workflow and signing code are not supplied, so the shared signing identity, keychain access group and MDM identifiers across production/dev/staging cannot be verified here and relate to A-011/A-017 trust of build identities. The claims about coordinator-side behavior (the 429/503 capacity messages, the cold-load routing) belong to platform-owned code. No concrete security regression is evidenced by the changelog text alone; behavior claims need code-level review of the actual source files, which are outside the supplied units. needs_deeper_review is set because the underlying code changes (staging publish workflow, loop-exit guard, SSD prefix cache defaults for GLM) were not supplied.
